ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising_edge timing used by all clocked processes; sequences updates of bus_access, irq_generator, transceiver, chip_select and clock_generator registers such as ctrl, bus_rsp_o, irq_o, rtx_engine, spi_csn_o, spi_clk_en and cdiv_cnt.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in bus_access, irq_generator, transceiver, chip_select, clock_generator processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Supplies asynchronous reset condition used by all clocked processes; on rstn_i='0' those processes reset ctrl, bus_rsp_o, irq_o, rtx_engine fields, spi_csn_o, spi_clk_en and cdiv_cnt.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then branches in all clocked processes (bus_access, irq_generator, transceiver, chip_select, clock_generator)

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Declared bus request record; the source fields of this record are consumed individually (stb, rw, addr, data). The whole record identifier itself is not read as an aggregate here.
ports.evidence: Only member fields (bus_req_i.stb, .rw, .addr, .data) are referenced in the source; bus_req_i as whole is not used

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.function: address bit used for register/FIFO select
ports.functionality: Consumes addr(2) to choose between control register space and FIFO data space and gates read/write operations; it controls whether ctrl fields or FIFO data are accessed and gates FIFO read/write enables.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then ... in bus_access; used in concurrent tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re when expressions

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies write-data bits that are captured into ctrl fields on bus writes and supplies the two slices used to form tx_fifo.wdata (data(31) and data(7 downto 0)).
ports.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl.* <= bus_req_i.data(...); tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(31) & bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced anywhere in this source; no functional effect inside this entity.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.ben in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Gates bus-access activity and supplies the acknowledge value; it gates write/read handling, drives bus_rsp_o.ack and contributes to FIFO enables (tx_fifo.we, rx_fifo.re).
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ... in bus_access; tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re when-expressions use bus_req_i.stb; bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Chooses the write-versus-read path in bus_access and gates FIFO read/write enables; it governs whether ctrl fields are written or bus_rsp_o.data is driven from FIFOs.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... else ... in bus_access; used in when-expressions for tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared but not used in this entity.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.src in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.priv in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.debug in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.amo in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.amoop in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.lock in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.fence in the source

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Constructs the response record each clock from ack, err and data subfields; the record is assembled from internal bits (bus_rsp_o.ack, .err, .data) driven in bus_access.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o <= rsp_terminate_c at reset; individual bus_rsp_o.* assigned in bus_access process

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Captured each rising edge from bus_req_i.stb and exported to the bus; provides the acknowledge value derived directly from bus_req_i.stb.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb inside rising_edge(clk_i) in bus_access

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Captured each cycle and driven to the constant '0' in the bus_access process; reports no error from this entity (assigned literal).
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' inside rising_edge(clk_i) in bus_access (assigned constant)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Holds readback and status bits constructed from ctrl fields, FIFO status and rx data; individual bits are carried or derived from ctrl.*, rx_fifo.rdata and fifo status signals to present status or read data on the bus.
ports.evidence: bus_access assigns individual bus_rsp_o.data(bits) <= ctrl.* or fifo signals; bus_rsp_o.data(7 downto 0) <= rx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0)

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Drives an external clock-enable output directly from ctrl.enable and exports that internal enable to the outside.
ports.evidence: clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable (concurrent assignment at end of architecture)

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Supplies bits indexed by ctrl.prsc to the clock generator; the selected clkgen_i bit participates in the condition that enables spi_clk_en.
ports.evidence: clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) = '1' used in clock_generator condition

ports.name: spi_clk_o
ports.functionality: Driven directly from the internal rtx_engine.sck signal and exported off-chip; presents the engineered SPI SCK to the external pins.
ports.evidence: spi_clk_o <= rtx_engine.sck (concurrent assignment)

ports.name: spi_dat_o
ports.functionality: Driven combinationally from the MSB of rtx_engine.sreg (bit 7) and exported as the MOSI/MISO output depending on configuration.
ports.evidence: spi_dat_o <= rtx_engine.sreg(7) (concurrent assignment)

ports.name: spi_dat_i
ports.functionality: Supplies incoming serial data which is sampled into rtx_engine.sdi_sync in the transceiver state machine and then shifted into sreg.
ports.evidence: rtx_engine.sdi_sync <= spi_dat_i inside transceiver when state "110"

ports.name: spi_csn_o
ports.functionality: Captured each clock in chip_select: defaults to all '1' and conditionally drives the indexed bit low according to rtx_engine.cs_ctrl; exports CS lines to external SPI slaves.
ports.evidence: spi_csn_o <= (others => '1') and indexed assignment using rtx_engine.cs_ctrl inside chip_select process

ports.name: irq_o
ports.functionality: Captured each rising edge from a boolean combination of ctrl.enable, ctrl.irq_* fields, fifo status and rtx_engine.busy; reports internal event conditions to the outside.
role: derived from control and FIFO status
ports.evidence: irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ( ... ) inside rising_edge(clk_i) in irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Aggregate register built from bus writes of bus_req_i.data; individual fields are captured on bus writes and used throughout the SPI logic (clock gen, transceiver and IRQ generator).
role: provides control for clocking and IRQs
signals.evidence: ctrl fields assigned in bus_access process from bus_req_i.data and reset at rstn_i

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Captured from bus_req_i.data when written; gates the clock generator and is used in IRQ generation and as clkgen_en_o output.
signals.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in bus_access; used in clock_generator and irq_generator; clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable

signals.name: ctrl.cpha
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used by the transceiver to influence sck transitions and sample timing; appears both as a condition and as an operand in sck assignments.
signals.evidence: ctrl.cpha <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cpha_c) in bus_access; used in transceiver (if ctrl.cpha = '1', and in expressions ctrl.cpha xor ctrl.cpol)

signals.name: ctrl.cpol
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used to set the idle SCK level and to compute driven SCK values in the transceiver.
role: drives idle and active SCK levels
signals.evidence: ctrl.cpol <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cpol_c) in bus_access; used in transceiver assignments to rtx_engine.sck

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and consumed as an index into clkgen_i to select the clock gating bit used by the clock generator.
signals.evidence: ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c) in bus_access; clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) used in clock_generator

signals.name: ctrl.cdiv
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and compared with the internal cdiv_cnt; that comparison decides when spi_clk_en pulses and when cdiv_cnt resets.
role: compares against counter to produce spi clock enable
signals.evidence: ctrl.cdiv <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cdiv3_c downto ctrl_cdiv0_c) in bus_access; used in (cdiv_cnt = ctrl.cdiv) comparison in clock_generator

signals.name: ctrl.highspeed
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used together with the selected clkgen_i bit to immediately allow spi_clk_en pulses when set.
signals.evidence: ctrl.highspeed <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_highspeed_c) in bus_access; used in clock_generator condition with clkgen_i(...)

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_avail
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used in the irq_o expression to enable IRQ when RX FIFO has data.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_avail <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_avail_c); used in irq_o <= ctrl.enable and (ctrl.irq_rx_avail and rx_fifo.avail) ...

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_empty
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used in irq_o to qualify an IRQ when TX FIFO is empty.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_empty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_empty_c); used in irq_generator expression

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used in irq_o to qualify an IRQ when TX FIFO not at half level.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_nhalf_c); used in irq_generator expression

signals.name: ctrl.irq_idle
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used in irq_o to enable idle-condition IRQ when TX FIFO empty and rtx_engine not busy.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_idle <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_idle_c); used in irq_generator expression

signals.name: cdiv_cnt
signals.functionality: Counts up each cycle when ctrl.enable and the selected clkgen bit or highspeed condition allow; compared against ctrl.cdiv to generate a spi_clk_en pulse then resets to zero.
signals.evidence: cdiv_cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cdiv_cnt) + 1) and compared (cdiv_cnt = ctrl.cdiv) in clock_generator

signals.name: spi_clk_en
signals.functionality: Generated when cdiv_cnt equals ctrl.cdiv or when ctrl.highspeed is asserted; its pulses gate the transceiver's per-bit state transitions (many rtx_engine updates).
signals.evidence: spi_clk_en set when (cdiv_cnt = ctrl.cdiv) or ctrl.highspeed or clkgen_i(...) in clock_generator; used as if (spi_clk_en = '1') then ... in transceiver

signals.name: rtx_engine
signals.functionality: Record holding the state machine and its working registers (state, sreg, bitcnt, sdi_sync, sck, cs_ctrl, done); individual fields are updated in the transceiver process and used elsewhere (CS, RX FIFO, SPI outputs).
role: forwards shifts and control to outputs
signals.evidence: rtx_engine fields assigned in transceiver process and used in chip_select, rx_fifo and spi outputs

signals.name: rtx_engine.state
signals.functionality: Captured and updated in the transceiver state machine; bit(2) is driven from ctrl.enable and the low bits select sub-states, which also select FIFO read and control flows.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable; case rtx_engine.state is ... controls behavior; tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (rtx_engine.state = "100")

signals.name: rtx_engine.busy
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived from rtx_engine.state (non-zero low bits indicate activity); exposed to bus readback as part of ctrl_busy flag calculation.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.busy <= '0' when (rtx_engine.state(1 downto 0) = "00") else '1' (concurrent)

signals.name: rtx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Holds the byte being shifted out/in; captured from tx_fifo.rdata on start, shifted in from rtx_engine.sdi_sync on bit transfers and feeds spi_dat_o and rx_fifo.wdata.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0) in state "100"; shifted via rtx_engine.sreg <= rtx_engine.sreg(6 downto 0) & rtx_engine.sdi_sync; rx_fifo.wdata <= '0' & rtx_engine.sreg

signals.name: rtx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Incremented each relevant spi clock (when spi_clk_en) and tested to detect end-of-byte; used to decide last-bit behaviour and done set.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.bitcnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(rtx_engine.bitcnt) + 1) in state "110"; tested if rtx_engine.bitcnt(3) = '1' in state "111"

signals.name: rtx_engine.sdi_sync
signals.functionality: Samples spi_dat_i into a registered signal during the transceiver sequence (on spi clock phases) and supplies the bit shifted into sreg.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.sdi_sync <= spi_dat_i in transceiver state "110"; used in sreg shift assignment

signals.name: rtx_engine.sck
signals.functionality: Registered internal clock line driven from ctrl.cpol/cpha logic in the transceiver and used to drive the external spi_clk_o output.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.sck assigned variously from ctrl.cpol and (ctrl.cpha xor ctrl.cpol) in transceiver; spi_clk_o <= rtx_engine.sck

signals.name: rtx_engine.cs_ctrl
signals.functionality: Captured from tx_fifo.rdata when a CS word is read and later used (bit3 as enable and bits2:0 as index) to select which spi_csn_o bit is asserted low.
signals.evidence: if tx_fifo.rdata(8) = '1' then rtx_engine.cs_ctrl <= tx_fifo.rdata(3 downto 0) in transceiver; chip_select uses rtx_engine.cs_ctrl(3) and rtx_engine.cs_ctrl(2 downto 0)

signals.name: rtx_engine.done
signals.functionality: Set by the transceiver at the end of a byte and cleared each clock; its rising pulse causes writing into rx_fifo.we.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.done <= '1' on final bit in state "111"; rx_fifo.we <= rtx_engine.done (concurrent)

signals.name: tx_fifo
signals.functionality: Aggregate representation of the TX FIFO interface signals (we, re, wdata, rdata, avail, free, clear, half); individual fields are driven/consumed by this entity and by the instantiated FIFO.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo fields used in concurrent assignments and instance port map to neorv32_fifo

signals.name: tx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Derived combinationally from bus_req_i.stb, bus_req_i.rw and bus_req_i.addr(2); enables writes into the instantiated TX FIFO when a bus write to FIFO address occurs.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Derived combinationally from the transceiver state; asserts a read when the engine is in the starting state to fetch the next word from TX FIFO.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (rtx_engine.state = "100") else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Formed combinationally from bus_req_i.data(31) and bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0) and presented to the TX FIFO instance when tx_fifo.we is asserted.
role: carries write payload to TX FIFO
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(31) & bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

signals.name: tx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Provided by the instantiated TX FIFO and consumed by the transceiver to either load CS control or load the transmit shift register.
signals.evidence: transceiver reads tx_fifo.rdata(8) and either uses rdata(3 downto 0) or rdata(7 downto 0) in state "100"

signals.name: tx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Provided by the FIFO instance and used to indicate whether TX data is available; used in bus readback and in ctrl_busy calculation.
role: influences bus status and IRQ logic
signals.evidence: bus_access reads not tx_fifo.avail into bus_rsp_o.data; irq_generator and bus_access use tx_fifo.avail

signals.name: tx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Provided by the TX FIFO instance and used to reflect fullness status in bus readback (inverted to produce TX full indication).
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_full_c) <= not tx_fifo.free

signals.name: tx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Driven combinationally from ctrl.enable (negated) to clear the TX FIFO when the module is disabled.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable (concurrent)

signals.name: tx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Provided by the FIFO instance and used to reflect a half-full condition in bus readback and in irq generation (negated as TX not-half).
role: influences bus status and IRQ logic
signals.evidence: bus_access uses not tx_fifo.half for ctrl_tx_nhalf; irq_generator uses (not tx_fifo.half) in expression

signals.name: rx_fifo
signals.functionality: Aggregate of RX FIFO interface signals; instance provides rdata/avail/free/half and this entity drives we, wdata and re as its RX path.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo fields used in instance port map and in concurrent assignments

signals.name: rx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Driven directly (concurrent) by rtx_engine.done to write the completed received byte into the RX FIFO.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.we <= rtx_engine.done (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: rx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Derived combinationally from bus_req_i.stb, bus_req_i.rw and bus_req_i.addr(2); a bus read to the FIFO address asserts rx_fifo.re.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

signals.name: rx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Composed from the current rtx_engine.sreg (MSB padded with '0') and presented to the RX FIFO when rtx_engine.done asserts.
role: carries received byte to RX FIFO
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= '0' & rtx_engine.sreg (concurrent)

signals.name: rx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Provided by the RX FIFO instance and read during bus reads to return the received byte on the bus.
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data(7 downto 0) <= rx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0)

signals.name: rx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Provided by the instance and used to indicate received-data availability in bus readback and in IRQ generation.
signals.evidence: bus_access uses rx_fifo.avail for ctrl_rx_avail readback; irq_generator uses rx_fifo.avail in irq expression

signals.name: rx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Provided by the instance; not referenced in this source other than via the instance (no explicit reads present here).
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.free is part of FIFO port map but not referenced elsewhere in the source

signals.name: rx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Driven combinationally from ctrl.enable (negated) to clear the RX FIFO when the module is disabled.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable (concurrent)

signals.name: rx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Provided by the FIFO instance and available for readback; used for status but not otherwise processed in this source.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.half is exposed via FIFO port map and reflected in bus_rsp_o.data for status
